description.value: Cell-like bodies about eighteen micrometres across, recovered as loose aggregates from a surface crevasse on the unbound world of the Cold Margin in 2262 and never recovered since. They have a bounded membrane, an internal structure that repeats, and no chemistry anyone has matched to anything else in the register. The catalogue lists them as unclassified pending determination, and the determination has now been pending for fifty years.

notes.value: Four working groups have held the sample since 2262 and each has returned it in better condition than it arrived, having declined to consume any of it. There is now rather more documentation than material.
